paite: Huai lou in leng goutan ding a gam na hawm hun chiang un gamseh siangthou, TOUPA kiang ah thilpiak na bawl ding uhi. Adunglam tong singnih-le-sangnga, availam tong singnih, apum in gam siangthou ahi ding hi.
heading: Gamsung A TOUPA Tan

paite: Hiai ah mun siangthou a ding in adung leh avai tong zanga tuaktuak, kimvel ahi ding a, akimvel in tong zanga a za mun awng a-om ding ahi.
Huan hiai tehsa a kipan in adung tong singnih-le-sangnga leh avai tong singkhat na tehkhe ding a, huai ah Mun Siangthoupen a-om ding ahi.
Gamseh siangthou bel, mun siangthou a nasemmi, a-nna sem ding a TOUPA hong naih siampute a ding ahi ding a, a-inn mun ding un leh mun siangthou ding in gam siangthou ahi ding hi.
Mun dang adung tong singnih-le-sangnga, avai tong singkhat, Levi chi tempul a nasem mite tuam ding in, atenna khopi ding in a-om ding ahi.
Gamseh siangthou latsa zul ah khopi tan avai tong zanga leh adung tong singnih-le-sangnga na sep ding uhi, Israel inkote pumpi a ding ahi ding.

Huan kumpi tapa tan bel gam siangthou latsa leh khopi tan malam ah tumlam a tumlam nga in, suahlam a suahlam nga in a-om ding ahi. Adung bel tumlam gamgi a kipan a suahlam gamgi pha in, gamseh dang tan mah ahi.
heading: Kumpi Tapa Gam Ding

paite: Huai bel Israel gam a amah tantuam ahi ding ahi; ka vaihawmte'n ka mite anuaisiah nawn kei ding ua, Israel inkote anam tuamdan bang zel un gam ape zaw ding uhi.

Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Aw, Israel vaihawmte aw, hunta hen, hiamgamna leh kigapna tawpsanta unla; diktattak a vaihawm leh diktak a hih chingta unla, ka mite delhkhiak nak pen tawpsanta un, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
heading: Vaihawmtupa Dia Dan Khun

paite: Bukna dik, ephah dik leh bath dik na zat ding uh ahi.
Ephah leh bath akikim ding uh ahi, bath homer seh sawm a khen seh khat ahi ding a, ephah leng homer seh sawm a khen seh khat ahi sam ding; homer a kipan a tehkhiak ding ahi ding.
Huan shekel bel gerah sawmnih ahi ding a; shekel sawmnih toh shekel sawmnih-le-nga toh shekel sawm-le-nga gawmkhawm na mina uh khat toh kikim ahi ding hi.
Huan hiai thillat na lat ding uh ahi ding; buh homer khat zel ah ephah seh guk a khen seh khat leh buh man homer khat zel ah ephah seh guk a khen seh khat na pe ding uhi.
Huan sathau latdan ding kor khat zel ah bath seh sawm a khen seh khat; kor bel bath sawm ahi.

Israel gantatna mun hoih a kipan belamhon lak a zanih zel ah anou khat, nek ding lat ding in, halmang kithoihna ding in lemna thillat ding in amaute hihsianna bawlna ding in alat ding uh ahi, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
Gam a mi tengteng in Israel vaihawmpa kiang ah hiai thillat ape ding uh.

Ankuang luina ah, kha thak ah, Sabbath ni ah, Israel ankuanglui ni sehsa tengteng ah halmang kithoihna, nek ding lat, dawn ding latte lan in angaihtuah ding a; khelh ziak a kithoihna, nek ding lat, halmang kithoihna, lemna thillat Israel inkote kisiansakna ding in ama'n atumsak ding ahi.
Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: “Kha khatna, huai kha ani khat ni in ganhon a pan bawngtaltuai gensiatbei na la ding a, mun siangthou na siangsak ding ahi.
heading: Nopbawl Nite

paite: Huan siampu in khelh ziak a kithoihna sisan ala ding a, tempul kongpi biang leh maitam dohdan ning lite leh huang sungnungzaw pen kongpi baangka ah atat ding hi.
Huai kha ani sagih ni in hihkhak hiam theih louh ziak hiam a thil hihkhialmite a ding in leng huchi mah bang in na hih ding a, huchibang in tempul hihsianna na bawl ding hi.
"Akha khatna, huai kha ani sawm-le-li ni in Paikan Ankuang na lui ding ua; huan, ni sagih sung tanghou silngou soh louh na ne ding uh.
Huai ni in vaihawmpa'n amah leh agam a mi tengteng a ding in, khelh ziak a kithoihna ding bawngtaltuai atum ding ahi.

Ankuanglui hun ni sagih sung teng in bawngtaltuai gensiatbei sagih leh belamtal sagih zel TOUPA a ding in halmang kithoihna ding in atum ding; huan khelh ziak a kithoihna ding in niteng in keltal khat toh.
Huan tanghou lat ding in bawngtal khat zel ah ephah khat, belamtal khat zel ah ephah khat leh ephah khat zel ah sathau hin khat atum ding hi.

"Akha sagihna, huai kha ani sawm leh ni nga ni a ankuangluina ah ni sagih sung huchibang mah in ahih ding a, khelh ziak a kithoihnate, halmang kithoihnate, tanghou latte leh sathau latte atum ding ahi," achi hi.
